text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Transitional National Council holds extraordinary session on January 25 to vote party and election laws and privatisation legislation.
- President Liamine Zeroual will propose a date for general elections during consultations with party leaders.
- Taxes and increase in demand prompted consumer prices hike at beginning of Ramadan.
- Workers' union leadership plans meeting to elect a secretary general replacing Abdelhaq Benhamouda who will quit to to set up a political party.
- Parliamentary elections may take place on May 20.
- University teachers pursue strike in Tizi-Ouzou university.
- Secular opposition Socialist Forces Front (FFS) party denies its leaders were considering plans to dissolve the movement.
